ns2:section.sectionText: FIN 221 now contains an online component. More information about the online aspect of FIN 221 will be provided on the first day of lecture. Registration restricted thru November 28th College of Business students; Business Minors; Actuarial Science, & Econ majors; and ACES Agri-Finance, Agri-Accounting, & Consumer Economics majors. Any remaining seats will open to all interested students at approximately noon on Monday, November 29th . PREREQUISITES WILL BE ENFORCED. Students missing one or more prerequisite will be removed from the course.
